title: Accounts Assistant
description:
If you want a job where you'll actually get to do more than one thing, this could be worth a look.

This is a broad role, you won't spend five days a week doing nothing but processing invoices or chasing the same spreadsheet around.

What will you be doing?

It's a varied Accounts Assistant role, giving you exposure to several areas of the finance function rather than keeping you focused on just one.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing and allocating cash receipts to customer accounts
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies
- Managing the sales ledger and ensuring accounts are accurate and up to date
- Supporting credit control, chasing overdue invoices and resolving customer queries
- Processing supplier invoices and preparing regular AP payment runs
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving any differences
- Assisting with the preparation and submission of VAT returns
- Supporting month-end processes and the wider finance team as required

What are they looking for?

You don't need to be the finished article.

You'll probably have worked in an accounts or finance role already and have a reasonable understanding of how a finance department works.

Maybe you're an Accounts Assistant who wants more variety, or perhaps you've spent most of your time in purchase ledger, sales ledger or credit control and you're ready to broaden your experience.

Either way, you'll need to be comfortable with numbers, reasonably handy with Excel and the sort of person who notices when something doesn't look right rather than assuming somebody else will sort it.

Most importantly, you'll be keen to learn.

Why consider it?

You'll get exposure to different areas of finance, work alongside people you can learn from and have the opportunity to take on more responsibility as you develop.

What else?
- Hybrid and flexible working
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Various employee benefits / retail discounts

So, if your current role has started to feel a bit repetitive or you're simply ready for the next step, click apply now.

title: Claims Handler (Top Insurance Company)
description:
It should be no surprise that when this dynamic insurer decided to build a London Market Claims Team in the UK regions, it plumped for Leeds - it has been established locally for over 20 years, already boasts a significant claims team that comprises many of the region's most gifted insurance professionals, and has recently invested significantly in the acquisition of penthouse offices in perhaps Leeds' most prestigious office addresses.

It is arguably the most exciting insurance company in the market right now, using ingenuity combined with technical expertise and cutting-edge technology to underwrite risks that other insurers shy away from. This 'can do' attitude, coupled with an unwavering focus on client service, is serving it well; the business is currently enjoying 20% year on year growth, and is well on track to exceed its plans to double in size within 5 years.

Working in this new team, you will be handling specialist Professional Indemnity claims from a range of industry sectors such as Solicitors, Architects, Engineers and Consultants. You'll take responsibility for handling a portfolio of high-volume claims from first notification of loss through to final settlement. You'll update in-house and London market claim related systems in relation to individual claims and ensure stakeholders are kept apprised of key developments and key information. In addition, you'll diarise and triage claims as required by the Claims Handling Manual and subject these decisions to regular challenge and review. You'll also develop and maintain excellent working relationships with brokers, as well as working with the Claims Manager on claims initiatives and projects to reach specific goals.

You DO NOT need to have experience in Professional Indemnity claims as full training will be provided. However, you must have some previous experience in insurance claims handling. We are open to experience here and will consider claims specialists from a range of backgrounds, including but not limited to, personal lines, commercial or healthcare insurance. Crucially, you must be well-organised and efficient, with strong communication skills and the ability to analyse claims data in order to spot trends. Just as importantly, you'll have good IT (Microsoft Office) skills, including Word, Excel and Outlook, together with the ability to quickly learn new in-house systems.

Our client is based a stone's throw from Leeds railway station, close to the main public transport links and all the amenities the city centre has to offer. You will be welcome to work from home 1 day per week. In addition to a generous basic salary, you will receive a fantastic benefits package that includes a lucrative bonus and an impressive pension arrangement.

title: Clinical Coordinator
company: Integrated Health Care Management - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Purpose

To provide senior clinical leadership and operational management across the hospital/site during night shifts, ensuring safe, effective, and high-quality patient care.

Key Responsibilities

Clinical Leadership

Act as the senior nurse in charge of the hospital/site overnight

Provide guidance and support to ward staff across multiple units

Respond to clinical incidents, emergencies, and complex situations

Support care for patients with Mental health conditions

Operational Management

Oversee bed management, admissions, and patient flow during the night specific to the PICU

Coordinate staffing levels and redeploy staff where necessary

Ensure wards are safely staffed and operational

Decision Making

Act as the key decision-maker in the absence of senior daytime management

Escalate concerns appropriately to on-call managers or medical staff

Manage risk and ensure patient and staff safety

Communication

Liaise with on-call doctors, emergency services, and external agencies

Provide clear handovers to day staff and senior management

Support staff with advice and problem-solving

Governance & Safety

Ensure compliance with policies, procedures, and clinical standards

Lead on incident reporting and immediate response

Promote safeguarding, confidentiality, and duty of care

Person Specification

Essential

Registered Nurse RMN with active registration via the Nursing and Midwifery Council

Significant post-registration clinical experience

Strong leadership and decision-making skills

Ability to manage emergencies and work under pressure

Excellent communication and organisational skills

Desirable

Experience in a senior or supervisory role

Knowledge of hospital/site management procedures

Experience in mental health or acute care settings

Working Conditions

Night shifts only (typically 12-hour shifts)

Responsible for the entire hospital site

High level of responsibility and autonomy

Why Join Us?
- Access to mandatory training with opportunities for further professional development and career growth
- Auto enrolment Pension
- Career development opportunities
- Eligibility for blue light card

title: RTA Litigation Claims Handler
description:
Role: RTA Litigation Claims Handler
Location: Leeds City Centre, West Yorkshire
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000
Contract: Full time, permanent, hybrid

A well-established legal services organisation is seeking an experienced RTA Litigation Claims Handler to join its specialist Motability claims team.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in road traffic accident personal injury claims to join a supportive and collaborative team, where achieving positive outcomes for customers is at the heart of the role.
You'll have the opportunity to build on your existing technical knowledge, broaden your litigation experience and take responsibility for a varied and interesting caseload involving more complex and disputed claims.

The Role

Reporting to a Team Leader, you will manage a diverse caseload of Road Traffic Accident (RTA) personal injury claims, covering matters across the OIC, MOJ, Fast Track and MIB processes, as well as more complex and litigated cases.
You will have responsibility for progressing claims from initial instruction through to settlement or final resolution, providing clear legal guidance, managing disputes effectively and ensuring clients receive a consistently high level of service throughout.
The position will also offer valuable exposure to post-whiplash reform claims, particularly those involving disputed liability and quantum.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage a specialist caseload of Motability-related RTA personal injury claims
- Handle OIC, MOJ, MIB, Fast Track, complex and Part 8 litigated matters
- Progress claims from initial instruction through to settlement or resolution
- Develop appropriate strategies for resolving liability and quantum disputes
- Manage post-whiplash reform claims, including disputed matters
- Assess and value claims up to £20,000
- Provide clear and accurate legal advice in accordance with relevant procedures and internal policies
- Maintain strong client relationships and deliver a high standard of customer care
- Ensure claims are progressed efficiently and within appropriate timescales
- Work towards agreed quality, service and performance targets

About You

The ideal candidate will have previous experience handling RTA personal injury claims, ideally within a law firm, insurance company or specialist legal services environment.
You will ideally have:
- Previous experience handling Fast Track RTA claims
- Experience managing personal injury claims through litigation
- Strong knowledge of the OIC and MOJ processes
- Good understanding of Pre-Action Protocols and the Civil Procedure Rules
- Knowledge of tariff and non-tariff injury valuations
- Familiarity with the Judicial College Guidelines and assessment of general damages
- Excellent communication and client relationship skills
- A proactive, solutions-focused approach
- Experience working to targets, service levels and quality measures
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- The ability to manage a demanding caseload and prioritise effectively

Working Arrangements

The position operates on a hybrid working basis, providing a balance of office and home working. This approach is designed to support flexibility while maintaining effective collaboration and communication across the team.
Office attendance will be determined by the requirements of the role and wider team.

Benefits

The organisation offers a competitive benefits package, including:
- Employer pension contributions
- Annual bonus opportunity
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Flexible benefits package, including optional health and dental cover
- Insurance and lifestyle discounts
- Share scheme opportunities
- Employee discounts and cashback offers
- A range of additional wellbeing and lifestyle benefits

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced RTA claims professional looking to develop their litigation expertise within a specialist team, while working in an environment that values client outcomes, collaboration and professional development.

For a confidential conversation, please contact Lauren Hopkinson

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Location: Leeds, UK

Salary: £25k-£28.5k depending on experience

Type: Full time

About Dream Big Digital

Dream Big Digital is a boutique eCommerce and marketing agency based in Leeds, Yorkshire. We specialise in designing, building, and marketing online Shopify stores that excite customers and generate revenue. Our small but mighty team is passionate about helping ambitious brands sell more online through tailored, personal service.

We're looking for a Social Media Coordinator to join the team and support the delivery of high-performing social content and influencer collaborations across our ecommerce client portfolio.

The Role

This is a varied, hands-on role for someone with a strong interest in social media, content and eCommerce marketing. Working closely with our Marketing Director, designers and wider team, you'll help plan and deliver engaging social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands, alongside supporting influencer campaigns.

A key part of the role will be coming up with creative ideas that help brands stand out on social, turning marketing priorities, products and promotions into engaging content. You'll be involved in everything from planning content calendars and writing copy to briefing creative, coordinating influencers and reviewing what's performing.

You don't need to be a specialist in every area. We're looking for someone who is creative, organised, commercially aware and genuinely excited by social media, while being comfortable managing a varied workload across multiple brands.

Experience managing organic social media for eCommerce brands would be a big advantage.

What You'll Be Doing
- Planning and supporting organic social media activity across a range of eCommerce brands
- Developing creative ideas for social posts, campaigns, Reels and other short-form content
- Writing engaging, on-brand social media copy
- Creating and managing social content calendars around key campaigns, launches, trends and seasonal moments
- Briefing designers and content creators on social assets and creative requirements
- Supporting the creation of simple social-first content, including capturing photos and short-form video where required
- Coordinating influencer and creator activity, including outreach, gifting and collaborations
- Keeping up to date with social media trends, platform developments and emerging content formats
- Reviewing social performance and using insights to help shape future content
- Writing marketing copy for blogs, landing pages and other digital content
- Working closely with the wider team to ensure client activity is delivered accurately and on time

What We're Looking For

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience in a social media, digital marketing, eCommerce or similar role
- Hands-on experience managing or supporting organic social media for brands
- A strong understanding of Instagram, Facebook and TikTok and the types of content that work across each platform
- Strong written communication and copywriting skills
- Confidence developing creative content ideas and contributing to campaign planning
- A good eye for engaging social content and current trends
- Good commercial awareness and an understanding of how social media can support brand awareness, engagement, traffic and sales
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confidence managing multiple brands, tasks and deadlines
- The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with a small team
- A genuine interest in social media, eCommerce and digital marketing

Particularly Useful Experience
- These aren't essential, but we'd particularly love to hear from you if you have experience with:
- Creating social content for eCommerce or consumer brands
- Planning and managing social media content calendars
- Influencer marketing, creator outreach or Shopify Collabs
- Creating or editing simple Reels and short-form video content
- Google Analytics or social media reporting tools
- Working within an eCommerce brand or digital agency

Benefits

The opportunity to work across a variety of exciting eCommerce brands and industries within a growing Shopify Plus Partner

A supportive, collaborative and creative working environment

Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

Real responsibility and ownership - your work will directly impact client growth

Flexible working arrangements, including hybrid working (home-based with two days in Leeds city centre)

Part of a growing, innovative team

25 days holiday plus bank holidays
